chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from a man, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
For grazing livestock, their owners are not held liable for anything so long as they are let loose.

key_terms.الْأَنْعَامِ: livestock such as camels, cattle, and sheep
key_terms.يُغْرَمُ: to be held financially liable or required to pay compensation

ai.seo_question: Are the owners of grazing livestock liable for damage caused while the animals are roaming freely?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding liability for grazing livestock. It indicates that the owners of such animals are not financially responsible for damage as long as the animals are left roaming in the ordinary unrestricted manner.
